events.summary: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has announced a public comment period for the proposed collection of information related to new animal drugs for minor use and minor species. This initiative, under the Paperwork Reduction Act, aims to gather input on the necessity, accuracy, and burden of the information collection process. events.summary: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has announced the withdrawal of approval for 11 abbreviated new drug applications (ANDAs) from various applicants, effective March 23, 2026. The applicants, including Masuu Global Solutions LLC and others, requested the withdrawal as the drugs are no longer marketed. This action means that these drugs cannot be introduced into interstate commerce without an approved new drug application or ANDA. The withdrawal is without prejudice to refiling.
